templates.title: Traefik Reverse Proxy
templates.description: Traefik v3 reverse proxy with automatic Let's Encrypt TLS, Docker provider, and file-based dynamic configuration.
templates.note: After deploying, place dynamic configuration files in the ./dynamic/ directory. Traefik auto-reloads on file changes.

templates.title: Authentik (Traefik)
templates.description: Authentik Identity Provider with Traefik reverse proxy integration. Uses Docker labels for automatic service discovery.

env.name: PG_PASS
env.label: PostgreSQL Password
env.description: Password for the Authentik PostgreSQL database

env.name: AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY
env.label: Authentik Secret Key
env.description: Secret key for Authentik (generate with: openssl rand -base64 60)

templates.note: Requires an existing Traefik instance with the 'traefik_net' Docker network. Run authentik-init.sh first to generate secrets, or provide them manually via the environment variables above.
